text: Act 1 begins with the chain. Its four papers produce 77 audit rows. The later bounce paper says the earlier spin-fluid foundation is not self-consistent and violates the cosmological principle. That is the paper's own verdict, not ours. One treatment uses repulsive stiff torsion and a smooth turning point. The other uses an attractive Dirac correction with a cusp-like velocity jump. They are incompatible mechanisms, not one bounce.
